props.title: In the next 15 minutes
props.markdown:
1. See why a lower orbit is a faster orbit.
2. Predict what a burn does to your orbit, and size a phasing burn.
3. Fly three rendezvous in a 3D lab around the Earth.

props.label: Speed of the ISS
props.body: Fast enough to circle the Earth in 93 minutes.

props.label: Speed of a geostationary satellite
props.body: Higher up, slower: one lap a day.

props.label: Gained per orbit
props.body: For each m/s of **braking**, 500 km up.
